FULL TEXT:
DOON UNIVERSITY
Mothrowala Road, Kedarpur, Dehradun, Uttarakhand – 248001
WALK-IN-INTERVIEW FOR THE POST OF YOUNG
PROFESSIONAL (YP-I) in NASF Project
Eligible candidates are invited to attend a Walk-in-Interview for a temporary position of Young Professional (YP)
under the National Agricultural Science Fund (NASF) funded research project at Doon University, Dehradun.
The details of the position and interview schedule are given below: No TA/DA will be paid for attending the
interview.
Details Specifications
Position Name Young Professional-I (YP-I)
Number of Vacancies 01 (One)
Project Name Comparative Study on Carbon Dynamics and Functional Rhizosphere
Microbial Biomass of Agroforestry system in Dry and Wet Tropical Climatic
Conditions
Tenure Six (06) Months
Emoluments Rs 30,000/pm
Date of Interview 26th September 2026
Reporting Time 11:00 AM
Venue Composite Laboratory Building, Room No. 406, Doon University, Dehradun
Eligibility Criteria
Essential Qualifications: Master’s Degree (M.Sc.) in Environmental Science, Agricultural Science, or a
closely related discipline from a recognized University.
Desirable Experience: Strong proficiency in data handling and statistical analysis. Hands-on experience with
statistical software (like R, SPSS, or SAS) and data management tools is highly preferred.
Age Limit: Minimum 21 years and maximum 45 years (Relaxation applicable as per Government of India
norms).
Instructions for Candidates
What to Bring: Candidates must bring their updated Curriculum Vitae (CV), one set of self-attested copies of
educational certificates/experience letters, a passport-size photograph, and all original documents for
verification. Reporting: Candidates should report at the venue by 11:00 AM on the day of the interview
Principal Investigator
Doon University, Dehradun
